items.name: Vaani Developer Platform
items.tagline: The only voice AI harness that you'll ever need
items.description: Build a voice agent that sounds and behaves human without writing a single line of code. Design the call flow, handle objections and edge cases, connect your tools and knowledge base, and go live on a real phone number. Every call ends with clean, structured data.

items.name: Knocket AI
items.tagline: Chat with visitors from your website or link
items.description: Give visitors a way to say hello. Add free live chat to your website or app, or turn your bio link into a personal contact page. Visitors can start chatting without signing up. Built for founders, creators, and small teams.

items.name: SpeakON Agent
items.tagline: Turn natural speech into real work for an agent to complete
items.description: Turn natural speech into real work with SpeakON Agent. It understands your Notes, connects your tools, and prepares Actions for you to review and confirm.

items.name: MCP Server by XWiki
items.tagline: Give your AI your wiki's knowledge while keeping the control
items.description: XWiki MCP Server is an open-source, self-hostable extension that connects XWiki to the AI agent of your choice: OpenCode, Pi, Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and more. You can already use the extension to query your knowledge base to get answers, create and edit pages, and work with structured data directly in XWiki. Try out the extension and let us what's should we improve next!

items.name: Canva Brush
items.tagline: A vision-language model that edits your designs
items.description: Canva Brush is a vision-language model for design from Canva Research. It sees your design, understands how it’s put together, and makes the changes you ask for, from one line of copy to every slide in a deck. Everything stays fully editable. Canva says it’s up to 69% faster and 46% lower cost per edit task than its previous design agent. It’s powering Canva AI design edits for Canva Pro subscribers today.

items.name: Chopstick
items.tagline: Mac activity and action widgets that write themselves
items.description: Chopstick notices what you repeat on your Mac and builds notch widgets for it, using the coding agent you already have. Your activity log stays local.

items.name: fastbrowse
items.tagline: Fastest open source browser agent
items.description: A fast open-source browser agent. It reads every button, link and field on the page and has a System One model (ex: jev) pick the next step from that list. If it's unsure, it falls back to a standard model model. Fast, cheap, and every answer provides a citation.

items.name: Teable Mobile
items.tagline: Build the systems your team runs on, now from your phone
items.description: Explain your process like you would to a new hire. Teable builds the database, the app and the automations, so the work stops living in your head. Now you can do it from your phone: hold to talk, publish to your team, and get notified when it's done.

items.name: iSurge
items.tagline: Activity monitor, per-app volume, disk cleanup at your notch
items.description: iSurge is one app for people who live on their Mac: live stats at the notch, each app's volume and mic, disk clean-up, an uninstaller, dev tools for ports, projects and Homebrew, a focus timer and Keep Awake. $14.99 once, $10.99 with PHPROMO20. No account.

items.name: Faylee
items.tagline: Bug reports your coding agent can fix from one link
items.description: Faylee records the screen, console, every network request and each click behind a bug, on one timeline, and shares it all as one link. Your team opens it and sees exactly what broke, with the failing request already open. Paste the link into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and Faylee's MCP server gives the agent the whole report so it can find the cause and fix it. Instant replay saves the last few minutes after a bug already happened. Free for up to 3 members.

items.name: Nocto
items.tagline: Your MacBook notch, finally useful
items.description: Nocto turns your MacBook's notch into a small control center. Hover to see what's playing and skip songs. Ten minutes before a call it starts a countdown, and when the meeting begins the notch opens with a Join button (Zoom, Meet, Teams, Webex, FaceTime). Park files on the shelf, find anything you copied in clipboard history, and check your Mac and AirPods battery at a glance. Native, light, macOS 14+. One-time purchase, 7-day free trial. Music stays free forever.

items.name: SparkBots AI (Powered by Jev)
items.tagline: Instantly extract key details and analyze any webpage or PDF
items.description: SparkBots can be trained to deeply analyze any web page or PDF. Once trained, your Sparkbot can be run on similar pages returning answers in less than a second. Perfect for analyzing and extracting key details for leads, businesses, resumes, listings, contracts or any PDF. SparkBot use AI, but it isn't a slow LLM like Claude or ChatGPT. It can't hallucinate or make up details that don't exist. Every answer comes straight from the content on the page and anything it doesn't find is left blank.

items.name: ilse
items.tagline: Point at your app and your AI agent changes the code
items.description: Ilse puts a toolbar on top of the React app you already have running. Click an element and say what should change, drag to reorder, resize, or tweak spacing and colors with your project's own tokens. Simple tweaks land instantly, with no AI. The rest goes to the agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini), pointing at the right spot in the code. Pro adds test mode: Ilse walks real user journeys on her own and reports what breaks.

items.name: Cluinn
items.tagline: Answers your questions during the call, not after. For Mac.
items.description: Someone asks a question on a call and you need the answer now. Cluinn listens on your Mac and answers mid-call from what was just said, with no bot joining the meeting. Smart Cards flag a question nobody answered. When the call ends you get the action items, and Coach shows how the call went against a goal you set. It also does AI dictation: speak, and clean text lands in any Mac app. For Apple silicon Macs. 14-day trial; LAUNCH30 takes 30% off for 12 months.

items.name: Norah Studio
items.tagline: A new space to explore your music
items.description: Norah Studio is a creative studio for exploring, transforming and reimagining your music on Mac, iPad and iPhone. Isolate tracks, loop by bars, adjust tempo and key, follow chords, add effects, build harmonies, turn melodies into instruments and export audio or MIDI. Everything runs on your device. Choose a subscription or a one-time purchase; either unlocks Pro on iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account.

items.name: Axonnic
items.tagline: Muscle-sensing sleeves for robot training
items.description: Axonnic’s forearm sleeve records muscle signals to track finger movement and estimate fingertip force. We combine EMG, video and hand pose into training datasets for robot tasks such as sewing, tool handling and delicate assembly.

items.name: Kestrix
items.tagline: Repo-agnostic CI control plane with DAG-based triggers.
items.description: Kestrix defines CI/CD pipelines in HCL and resolves them into a DAG. A task runs only when the repositories its trigger names have changed. Live task logs in a React Flow UI, and remote runners that only make outbound HTTPS requests.

items.name: StepGrab
items.tagline: Now on Windows, with redaction and a real editor
items.description: New since our first launch: StepGrab runs on Windows, and projects open on Mac and PC. Black out emails, names or prices, and the box is burned into every export so nobody can lift it off. Every guide opens in an editor: rewrite steps, add arrows, boxes and text, reorder, undo. The direct Mac download reads the real name of every button you click. Still the core: every click becomes a screenshot, arrow and sentence. No account, nothing uploaded. 5 free Lifetime licenses: see the comments :)

items.name: StereoLift Live
items.tagline: your desktop in real 3D, live on your Quest
items.description: Run StereoLift Live on a Windows or Linux PC with an NVIDIA GPU. View your desktop in stereoscopic 3D on Meta Quest over your local network.

items.name: sitesolide
items.tagline: Deploy your vibe-coded apps on your own server
items.description: You built an app with Claude Code or Cursor and want it online. Run sitesolide deploy in its folder and it goes live on your server, on HTTPS, at its own address. Each app is isolated from the others, and you choose who can open it. Free and open source (MIT): you pay for the server and a domain.
